description:
Enterprise-grade .NET 8 Web API template with Clean Architecture, comprehensive security features (60% hardened), 
      JWT authentication, role-based access control, SignalR real-time messaging, rate limiting, token versioning, 
      encrypted ticket system for BOLA/IDOR protection, and configurable session management.
      
      Includes: JWT auth, encrypted payloads, token versioning, rate limiting (AspNetCoreRateLimit), BOLA/IDOR protection,
      secrets management, session management (Single/Multiple/Limited modes), SignalR hub, user invitations, 
      comprehensive documentation, and security audit tracking.
      
      Perfect for building secure enterprise APIs with modern .NET practices.
releaseNotes:
Version 1.0.0 - Initial Release (60% Security Complete)

✅ COMPLETED SECURITY FEATURES (12/20):
• JWT Authentication with HS256 algorithm and encrypted payloads (AES-256)
• Token versioning for session management and concurrent attack prevention
• Encrypted ticket system (BOLA/IDOR protection) with AES-256 + HMAC
• Comprehensive rate limiting with AspNetCoreRateLimit (5 login attempts per 15min)
• Secrets management (User Secrets for dev, Environment Variables for prod)
• Session management (SingleSession, MultipleSession, Limited modes)
• Role-based authorization (Admin, SuperAdmin, Finance)
• HTTPS enforcement with HSTS and secure cookies
• CORS configuration with proper headers
• Password security with PBKDF2 hashing
• SignalR real-time messaging with JWT authentication
• Refresh token implementation with SHA-256 hashing and rotation

🏗️ ARCHITECTURE:
• Clean Architecture (5 layers: API, Application, Domain, Persistence, Services)
• CQRS pattern with MediatR
• Repository pattern with Entity Framework Core
• PostgreSQL database with migrations
• FluentValidation for input validation

📚 FEATURES:
• User management with ASP.NET Core Identity
• Email invitation system for user registration
• Multi-device session tracking
• Logout from current/all devices
• Real-time messaging (private/group chat, typing indicators, online status)
• Comprehensive Swagger documentation
• Test endpoints for development
• Extensive documentation (README, SECURITY_AUDIT, implementation guides)

🚧 COMING IN v1.1 (Target: 80% Security):
• Comprehensive audit logging (all security events)
• Token blacklist on logout
• Input sanitization (XSS protection)
• Account lockout mechanism
• SQL injection prevention audit

📦 WHAT'S INCLUDED:
• 5-layer clean architecture structure
• JWT authentication with encrypted claims
• Rate limiting configuration
• SignalR hub setup
• Database migrations
• Secrets management setup
• Security documentation
• Test endpoints
• Sample implementations
summary:
Production-ready .NET 8 Web API template with Clean Architecture, advanced security (60% hardened), 
      JWT auth, SignalR, rate limiting, and comprehensive documentation.
title: BizBox Enterprise Web API Template
